pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English Lesson for Adults
pro_course_detail.description:
Enhance your English speaking skills through engaging conversation practice!

What to expect to learn: 
- Improved listening and confidence in speaking English.
- Expanded vocabulary and understanding of American English phrases.
- The ability to articulate thoughts more clearly and effectively in English.
- Personalized feedback and correction to facilitate progress.

How you can apply conversational practice:
English conversational practice is useful for travel, meeting new people, or preparing for the speaking/listening sections found in IELTS or Cambridge English assessments. 

Teaching methods: 
The lessons utilize freestyle conversation as the primary teaching method, promoting natural and spontaneous language use. I will also correct any errors throughout the lesson and suggest ways to phrase sentences like a native speaker would.

A 5-minute break is included in the lesson.

- Personalized feedback and correction to facilitate progress.

English grammar lessons are useful for more natural writing and speaking, enhanced understanding of written or spoken English, and improved grammar skills found in English language assessments.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for beginners) Inglés para principiantes
pro_course_detail.description:
This comprehensive ESL course is structured to take students from beginner to high-beginner proficiency.  By completing this course, students will gain confidence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing in English, preparing them for real-world communication.  

The course focuses on:  
- **Grammar**: Progressing from basic structures (*be verbs*, *present simple*, *past simple*, *future (going to)*) to more complex structures (*can/can't, comparatives, superlatives, present perfect*).  
- **Vocabulary**: Covering a wide range of topics, including numbers, nationalities, family, food, daily routines, and more.  
- **Pronunciation**: Emphasizing key English sounds, stress patterns, and rhythm to develop clear spoken communication.  
- **Speaking & Listening**: Engaging activities, dialogues, and real-life conversations to improve fluency and comprehension.  
- **Reading & Writing**: Practicing sentence structure, reading comprehension, and writing tasks ranging from simple messages to structured paragraphs.  
- **Practical English**: Everyday functional language, such as ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and handling real-world situations.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Communication**: Exploring cultural differences in communication, idiomatic expressions, and social norms.  
- **Review & Progress Checks**: Regular revision exercises and practical challenges to reinforce learning and track progress.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes intermedios
pro_course_detail.description:
Intermediate ESL Course for Confident Communication

This course is designed to help students at an intermediate level develop fluency and accuracy in English through engaging lessons that focus on:

Grammar Mastery: Strengthening sentence structures, tenses, and complex grammatical forms to express ideas clearly.
Expanded Vocabulary: Learning and using a wide range of words and phrases for everyday conversations, work, and travel.
Pronunciation Practice: Improving clarity and natural rhythm in speech through targeted exercises.
Speaking & Listening Skills: Engaging in discussions, role-plays, and real-world scenarios to build confidence in communication.
Reading & Writing Development: Understanding diverse texts, improving comprehension, and refining writing skills for emails, reports, and storytelling.
Practical English for Everyday Situations: Handling real-life interactions such as ordering in restaurants, solving travel problems, and making social connections.
Cultural Awareness & Social English: Navigating conversations with native speakers and understanding language in different contexts.
Regular Progress Checks: Reviewing learning through assessments and interactive activities to reinforce knowledge.
By the end of this course, students will have the tools to communicate effectively in a variety of real-life situations, gaining confidence and proficiency in English

pro_course_detail.title: (English for upper intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes de nivel intermedio superior
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Effective Communication**  
This is a well-structured, practical, and engaging curriculum. Each phase builds on the previous one, reinforcing knowledge while introducing new grammatical concepts in a way that feels organic and applicable to real-life communication.

This course is designed for students who want to refine their English skills and achieve a higher level of fluency and accuracy.

 The lessons focus on:  
- **Advanced Grammar & Structures**: Mastering complex sentence forms, including passive voice, conditionals, relative clauses, and reported speech.  
- **Expanded Vocabulary & Expressions**: Learning idiomatic expressions, phrasal verbs, and specialized vocabulary for different contexts.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation**: Developing a natural rhythm and clarity in speech through stress and intonation practice.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Real Situations**: Engaging in debates, storytelling, and discussions on various topics to build confidence in spontaneous conversation.  
- **Reading & Writing for Different Purposes**: Analyzing and producing formal and informal texts, including essays, reports, and narratives.  
- **Functional & Social English**: Navigating professional and social interactions, handling difficult conversations, and expressing nuanced opinions.  
- **Cultural Insights & Language in Context**: Understanding language variations, cultural references, and communication styles.  
- **Comprehensive Review & Practical Application**: Regular assessments and real-life applications to track progress and solidify learning.  

By the end of this course, students will have the skills to communicate effectively in both casual and professional environments, enhancing their confidence in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency**  

This course is designed for students who want to achieve full fluency and command of English at an advanced level. The lessons focus on:  

- **Sophisticated Grammar & Nuanced Structures**: Exploring advanced topics such as past modals, inversion, ellipsis, cleft sentences, and distancing language to enhance precision in communication.  
- **Rich & Diverse Vocabulary**: Expanding knowledge of idioms, phrasal verbs, colloquial expressions, and topic-based vocabulary in areas like psychology, business, and global issues.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation Refinement**: Perfecting natural rhythm, connected speech, and stress patterns for clear, confident, and native-like pronunciation.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Complex Contexts**: Engaging in in-depth discussions, debates, and professional conversations, and understanding a variety of accents and fast-paced speech.  
- **Reading & Writing for Academic & Professional Purposes**: Analyzing complex texts, writing structured essays, reports, and opinion pieces, and refining formal and informal writing styles.  
- **Social & Professional Communication**: Mastering English for networking, interviews, presentations, and persuasive discussions in both formal and casual settings.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Idiomatic English**: Understanding how language reflects cultural nuances, improving adaptability in global communication.  
- **Personalized Review & Application**: Frequent assessments, real-life simulations, and practical exercises to ensure measurable progress.  

By the end of this course, students will have achieved an advanced level of fluency, enabling them to communicate naturally and effectively in any setting, from academic to professional and everyday life.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for you if you want to:
* Spend less time translating in your head
* Speak for longer time frames without getting tired
* Learn phrases to help with any situation

Beginners: Even beginners should practice speaking in their target language! I’ve seen many people improve quickly this way. I’ll also use body language and write down anything you need as we talk.

Intermediate: Together, we can work on confidence and fluency techniques or just chat about a topic that interests you. We can also work on fixing common mistakes in your speech or develop more natural expressions.

Advanced: Maintain your English or practice expressing more complicated subject out loud. Although I have my own set of topics we can you, I encourage advanced learners to choose the topics themselves. That way, we can focus on whatever area of English you most want to practice.

During conversation practice, I let students finish their thoughts before correcting them. I am always willing to help if you’re searching for a word or phrase. I also take notes in the chat so you can review them after class if you’d like.

Welcome! Bienvenue! ようこそ! Céad míle fáilte! 欢迎！

In the trial lesson, I want to get to know you and your goals for learning English.

Where are you from? Why do you want to learn English? How long have you been studying? What are your strengths, and in which areas do you want to improve? We'll do a bit of speaking, listening, reading, and writing so I can get a sense of your abilities, and develop a lesson plan from there.

pro_course_detail.title: Fun English Conversation Practice with a Native Speaker
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice your English with a native speaker! We can discuss current events & culture, books & films, or practice scenarios you might encounter—like preparing for an interview, or traveling in the United States. I especially love to talk about traveling, if you're preparing for a big trip!

Throughout our conversation, I will take note of your English level and give you grammar tips, phrases to practice, useful slang, and help you better construct your sentences. I will also direct you toward resources to improve your speaking, writing, reading, and listening skills in between classes.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation & Accent Practice 🎤
pro_course_detail.description:
Talk like an American! Whether you want to improve your ability to communicate clearly with native speakers, imitate your favorite American TV stars, or sound more natural in your everyday speech—great accent ability begins with learning to listen, to hear the subtle differences between sounds and learn to mimic them yourself. In this class, we focus on three main areas of accent training:

(1) Pronunciation, particularly English short vowels and difficult consonants,
(2) Intonation, or the "music" of the language,
(3) Connected speech, or how to link and blend words naturally like an American English speaker,
(4) Common native expressions and filler words.

To begin, I'll analyze your current speech level and identify target areas to strengthen your pronunciation. At the sentence level, we'll look at how the English language stresses its words, and discuss the difference between stress-timed and syllable-timed resources. We'll also identify patterns in the ways that native English speakers blend their words when speaking casually (which should help you better understand TV shows and movies!) To round it all out, we'll practice including some common expressions and filler language in your speech, especially while speaking casually.

Lessons are tailored to each individual student. I draw upon a variety of resources to help to develop your speech skills, and will include sound clips for you to practice what we learn in each session. You can do it—let's have fun with accents!

pro_course_detail.title: English Writing & Grammar 📝
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, we focus on improving grammar and writing in the English language. Phrasal verbs, past perfect verb tenses, zero conditionals, and more! We will use short and long writing exercises (depending on the student's goals and preferences) to practice the grammar you're studying. As a writer, I love playing with words, finding the best way to express an idea, and I want to convey that grammatical enthusiasm over to you! 🤓📝

Short exercise: Compose a series of sentences using the target grammar in our lesson (for example, one sentence for each of the twelve English verb tenses). Then in class, we'll review the nuances and differences in meaning, both implied and explicit, by tweaking the words.

Long exercise: Write a short paragraph (100-500 words) telling me about a day in your life, a short story or essay, or an opinion of a book or TV show that you've recently watched. Anything that interests you! Then, during class, we will review your writing and correct it for grammar, language use, clarity, and word choice. We will discuss the differences in professional versus casual tone. This is a good class for students wanting to improve their essay-writing, professionals wanting to improve their email communications, and all other writers wanting to improve their command of English.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English 💼
pro_course_detail.description: In this class, we'll review the ways that English in the workplace can differ from friendly conversational English between friends; business English often uses a different set of vocabulary terms, idioms, and higher register of formality and politeness. We'll explore different ways to write an email, have conversations with your boss, and talk in meetings, with a bit of situational role play for you to practice! I draw upon my own experience working professionally as an architect, and I also encourage students to bring in examples of real-life language they encounter at their job, so we can discuss situations specific to their jobs and careers. Let's dive in!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids (Ages 4-15) 🎈
pro_course_detail.description:
Fun conversational classes for kids! Let them try out their English in a friendly, relaxed environment (this is the best way for anyone to learn, but especially children). I encourage them to talk about their interests, hobbies, favorite characters and toys. They can tell me about life in their home country, and ask questions about the United States and American culture! Depending on their skill level and interests, we'll learn new vocabulary, read some children's stories together, and play some grammar games to advance their English level.

I began my ESL career teaching English online to children in China and have taught over 2750 classes to over 1200 students, ages 4-15, predominantly 8-11 year olds, with a focus on grammar, pronunciation, and conversation skills.

pro_course_detail.title: WRITING COACH — COLLEGE ESSAYS
pro_course_detail.description:
This is an intensive class for (1) university or high school students at the C1/C2 level who want guidance and coaching while writing academic essays or applying to college, or for (2) writers for whom English is not their native language. I will share my passion for writing and storytelling, and help you level up your writing skills!

Personal essay, creative non-fiction, short stories, novels 📚

📝 Developmental editing: Concept & flow.
📝 Content editing: Big-picture examination of argument/theme/plot to strengthen the structure.
📝 Copy editing: Final proofing for sentence structure & grammar.
 
We begin with a 30-60 minute brainstorming session to help clarify and structure your ideas around the essay prompt; students should come to class with a rough draft, or at least an outline. The focus will be on big ideas and telling your story in the most powerful way possible—whether you're composing a fictional tale or real-life essay.

Then, after you redraft your essay, we will follow up with a 1-hour editing session focused on improving grammar and sentence structure to native-sounding level (this can be undertaken as a live lesson or as edits/detailed comments returned within 48 hours).

Estimate about 1,000 words per hour, which can vary by genre, complexity, level of polish.
